shortDesc: Where a word comes from, under an "Origin" label. Give it the word and it looks up the origin itself; or pass a short origin sentence in text when you already have it.

props.name: word
props.description: The word whose origin to look up.

props.name: text
props.description: Origin sentence to show instead of looking it up.

styling.notes: Mono uppercase label; Newsreader paragraph on a vellum panel with a gilt left rule.

interactions.trigger: component mounts (when word is set and text isn't)
interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'look up a word', word, outputFormat: { word, phonetic, origin, meanings: [...] } }
